questions.question: Which cell structure stores most of a plant or animal cell’s genetic information?
questions.feedback: Nucleus is the best choice because it contains most of the cell’s DNA.

questions.question: Which cell structure controls what enters and leaves the cell?
questions.feedback: Cell membrane is the best choice because it forms a selectively permeable boundary.

questions.question: Which cell structure provides rigid support outside a plant cell membrane?
questions.feedback: Cell wall is the best choice because its rigid structure helps support the cell.

questions.question: Which cell structure captures light energy for photosynthesis?
questions.feedback: Chloroplast is the best choice because it contains pigments that absorb light.

questions.question: Which cell structure releases usable energy from food during aerobic respiration?
questions.feedback: Mitochondrion is the best choice because it is a major site of aerobic respiration.

questions.question: Which cell structure helps maintain pressure in a plant cell?
questions.feedback: Large central vacuole is the best choice because water inside it helps keep the cell firm.

questions.question: Which cell structure provides a medium where many chemical reactions occur?
questions.feedback: Cytoplasm is the best choice because many reactions take place in this material inside the cell.

questions.question: Which cell structure assembles proteins?
questions.feedback: Ribosome is the best choice because it links amino acids to make proteins.
